run_command: run a shell command and return stdout or raise CommandError on failure
check_repo_clean: check if a git repository has uncommitted changes excluding the grids package folder
get_git_root: get the absolute path to the root of the current git repository
shallow_clone: create a shallow clone of a git repo and rename the target to the commit hash
to_absolute_path: convert a relative path to an absolute path using the original Dora execution directory
